changes.from: Maker pages (clonerobotics.com/android and the 19 Feb 2025 Protoclone announcement video on Clone's own channel) describe a faceless, anatomically accurate bipedal android actuated by over 1,000 Myofiber artificial muscles with a synthetic skeleton, vascular, nervous and muscular systems, over 200 degrees of freedom and roughly 500 sensors, powered by water and electricity, with an on-board GPU. Height, weight and an exact DoF count are not published by the maker, so those fields are empty (the seed 1,700 mm / 60 kg / 164 DoF figures came from HumanoidStore and are not maker values; 'over 200 DoF' is recorded here rather than in dof). The Alpha Edition is open for reservation of the first 279 units with no ship date, so status stays Announced.
